notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures.
description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Titania's second ability triggers, creating a 5/3 Elemental creature token.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Titania by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Titania enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, putting Gaea's Cradle onto the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.
